tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Reads a website's robots.txt and reports, for 11 AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Meta-ExternalAgent, CCBot, Bytespider), whether each may reach the given page. tools.name: view_page_as_ai_crawler
tools.description: Fetches one page the way most AI crawlers do (plain HTTP, no JavaScript) and reports what they actually receive: title, meta description, canonical, H1, heading count, structured data types, visible word count, token reading cost, and a text preview. Use it to check whether content is visible to AI

tools.name: explain_ai_crawler
tools.description: Explains what an AI crawler user agent does (operator, purpose, and what blocking it in robots.txt changes). Pass a name such as GPTBot or OAI-SearchBot, or omit it to list all crawlers Siteiz tracks.

tools.name: get_ai_visibility_report
tools.description: Returns a published, dated Siteiz AI visibility report for a well-known company's homepage (score, grade, pillar scores, top issues). Omit the company to list all published reports.

tools.name: list_my_sites
tools.description: Lists the sites in your Siteiz account with their latest AI readability score, open fixes and linked Search Console property. Needs a Siteiz Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer header).

tools.name: get_search_performance
tools.description: Clicks, impressions, CTR and average position from your connected Google Search Console, by query, page, device or country, for the last N days (data trails by about 3 days). Needs a Siteiz Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer header).

tools.name: get_traffic_ranked_fixes
tools.description: Joins your Search Console impressions with your latest Siteiz scan: scanned pages ranked by real Google impressions, each with its AI readability score and open fixes, plus pages with no impressions (possibly not indexed) and high-traffic pages the scan missed. tools.name: inspect_url_index
tools.description: Runs Google Search Console URL inspection on one page of your site: index verdict, coverage, robots.txt, last crawl, user and Google canonical, plus the page's Siteiz AI readability score. Needs a Siteiz Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer header).
